name: TaskQueue
summary: The work queue: what is waiting, what is running, what failed.

a11y.apg: none — it is an ordered list, and order is the queue's meaning

props.name: tasks
props.description: The queue. Six states and three priority steps, measured from the reference. The reference's task carries 15 fields and five of them belong to OTHER components in this same family — token and cost are ModelUsage and CostMeter, checkpoints are TraceTimeline, assignee is AgentCard. Absorbing them here would make the queue answer for four contracts and none of them properly.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Shows a retry button on failed tasks only. Without it a failure is reported and cannot be acted on.
